{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
valid_ages = sales['customer_age'][sales['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute and print the number of valid ages
num_valid_ages = len(valid_ages)
print("Number of valid ages (excluding -1 values):", num_valid_ages)

# Compute and print the mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()
print("Mean age of customers (excluding -1 values):", mean_age)

# Round to two decimal places for final answer
rounded_mean_age = round(mean_age, 2)
print("Rounded mean age:", rounded_mean_age)"}
